{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (e.g., < 0.33) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion or downward drift after a spike.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (last 3-5 days) when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Apply upward bias correction if model consistently underestimates prices during high sentiment (e.g., > 0.67) and true prices are trending up.",
    "Avoid over-optimistic forecasts after a sharp price spike — cap forecast growth at 10% above recent peak unless sentiment confirms continuation.",
    "If true outcome deviates > 10% from 30-day forecast, re-weight recent history (last 5 days) more heavily in next forecast.",
    "Use sentiment as a momentum filter: if sentiment > 0.5, allow 15% higher forecast; if < 0.3, apply 10% downward adjustment."
  ]
}
